text: Web: login flow drops the intended destination (incl. /redeem?token=...)

Done in b3ead29. ProtectedRoute passes state={{ from: location }} on the /login
redirect; LoginPage navigates to `${from.pathname}${from.search}` on success (query
preserved for /redeem?token=...), else "/". Tests (LoginPage.test.tsx) cover the
preserved-destination and the no-state fallback. Unblocks T-44's desktop path.
